findings.evidence: Strip.lean:272-275 `differentiableOn_mellinDis (hf : LocallyIntegrableOn f (Ioc 0 1)) {b : ℝ} (hb : f =O[𝓝[>] 0] fun x => x ^ (-b)) : DifferentiableOn ℂ (mellinDis f) {N | b < N.re}`; no declaration in the file concludes differentiability from `MellinDisConvergent` alone.
findings.fix: State what is proved: the bridge, the characterisation of convergence as `f ∈ L¹((0,1], x^(Re N−1) dx)` and its monotonicity in `Re N`, and holomorphy on `b < Re N` for `f = O(x^(−b))` as `x → 0⁺` with `f` locally integrable on `(0,1]`.
findings.issue: Overclaims what Strip.lean supplies: "the domain of convergence of `mellinDis` (a right half-plane) and its holomorphy there". Strip.lean gives no holomorphy on the domain of convergence for a general `f`; `differentiableAt_mellinDis`/`differentiableOn_mellinDis` require `LocallyIntegrableOn f (Ioc 0 1)` and `f =O[𝓝[>] 0] fun x => x ^ (-b)` and conclude only on `{N | b < N.re}`. Likewise the convergence domain is characterised (weighted `L¹`, upper set in `Re N`), not identified.

findings.evidence: Strip.lean:20-21 "the domain of convergence is a right half-plane"; Strip.lean:146 section header "## The domain of convergence is a right half-plane"; the only convergence-region results are `isUpperSet_setOf_mellinDisConvergent` (line 164) and `differentiableOn_mellinDis` on `{N | b < N.re}` (line 274).
findings.fix: Retitle to "The half-plane of convergence of the Mellin transform on the unit interval" (the PR title's own wording), keeping the sentence that relates it to the usual strip.
findings.issue: Module heading "The strip of convergence of the Mellin transform on the unit interval" contradicts the file's content and its own next paragraph: on `(0,1]` the region is a right half-plane, with no left boundary, and nothing in the file proves a two-sided strip. A reader scanning headings expects the roadmap's two-sided §0.4 strip statement.

summary: Per-declaration docstrings are complete and accurate, but the rewritten "Which transform" paragraph in Mellin.lean promises holomorphy on the whole domain of convergence, which Strip.lean does not prove, and Strip.lean's own heading says "strip" where the file proves a right half-plane.
